memories.content: Alistair directly orders Marcus to protect the main siphoning lens at the Origin Altar and authorizes Roland to overload the pressure system and burn the slum if the sewer route cannot be sealed.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The command is direct dialogue from Alistair to Marcus.

memories.chapter_title: CƠN BÃO KHO QUÂN NHƯ VÀ BÓNG TỐI ALISTAIR
memories.content: Sael’s uprising and the allied force capture the outer military arsenal, arm the slum fighters with stored mundane equipment, and force Roland’s remaining Temple forces to fall back toward the Inner Gate.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The arsenal gate falls, weapons are distributed, and Valora reports Roland’s retreat to the Inner Gate.

memories.chapter_title: BẢO BẠO CỔNG TRONG VÀ TIẾNG KHIÊN ĐỒNG SỤP VỠ
memories.content: The Inner Gate is the last major fortified choke point on the allied route from the slum/outer city toward the Great Cathedral and the Origin Altar defenses where Roland retreats.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The chapter presents the Inner Gate as the final heavy defensive barrier before the cathedral/altar ascent.

memories.chapter_title: BẢO BẠO CỔNG TRONG VÀ TIẾNG KHIÊN ĐỒNG SỤP VỠ
memories.content: Thần Tinh nullification projectiles fired by Bram, Brand and the allied force disable the Inner Gate’s thirty quang-energy cannons, stripping the defense of its magical fire support.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The two nullification projectiles hit the energy-feed junctions; the chapter says all thirty cannons lose power and collapse.

memories.chapter_title: BẢO BẠO CỔNG TRONG VÀ TIẾNG KHIÊN ĐỒNG SỤP VỠ
memories.content: Elena chemically weakens the Inner Gate mechanism while Sael’s team plants Thần Tinh charges; Alan triggers the breach, the gate collapses, and Roland retreats with surviving forces toward the cathedral stairs.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The gate-hinge sabotage, explosion, collapse and Roland retreat are explicitly narrated.

memories.chapter_title: BẢO BẠO CỔNG TRONG VÀ TIẾNG KHIÊN ĐỒNG SỤP VỠ
memories.content: After the Inner Gate falls, the alliance advances toward the Great Cathedral and Origin Altar; Valora says Roland has fallen back to the last line and Alistair awaits at the top, marking the final-assault phase.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The chapter ends with the coalition moving up the great stairs and explicitly declaring the final confrontation imminent.

memories.chapter_title: BẬC THANG ĐẠI THÁP VÀ TRẬN PHÁP THÁI DƯƠNG
memories.content: The Trận Pháp Thái Dương on the Great Cathedral stairs uses eight siphoning lenses linked to the cathedral energy system; Elena observes a short pressure-release interval between heat sweeps that creates an exploitable mechanical blind window.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Valora identifies eight solar siphoning lenses; Elena identifies a roughly three-second pressure-release cycle after each heat sweep.

memories.chapter_title: BẬC THANG ĐẠI THÁP VÀ TRẬN PHÁP THÁI DƯƠNG
memories.content: Alan and Elena exploit the Solar Array’s pressure/chemical weakness while Bram and Brand fire Thần Tinh nullification charges; the eight lenses and the protected pressure structure are destroyed, opening the ascent deeper into the cathedral.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Elena chemically disables the lens system; Bram and Brand launch nullification charges; the solar array collapses.

memories.chapter_title: BẬC THANG ĐẠI THÁP VÀ TRẬN PHÁP THÁI DƯƠNG
memories.content: After the Solar Array falls, Valora says Alistair is waiting at the Origin Altar and claims he has drained sixty percent of the Earth Vein power for a “divine ascension” ritual; the statement is Valora-attributed rather than narrator-confirmed motive.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Valora tells the group that Alistair is at the Origin Altar and characterizes his activity as a divine-ascension ritual.

memories.chapter_title: VÒM ĐIỆN THÁNH CƯỜNG VÀ BÓNG SÁT THỦ VESPERA
memories.content: Inside the Great Cathedral, twelve Vespera assassins ambush the coalition; Elena disrupts siphoning/sensor support, Bram and Brand destroy four copper power supports, and Valora’s/Gargas’s forces finish the now-depowered assassins.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The Vespera ambush is defeated after its powered support and sensor infrastructure are chemically and mechanically disrupted.

memories.chapter_title: VÒM ĐIỆN THÁNH CƯỜNG VÀ BÓNG SÁT THỦ VESPERA
memories.content: Vespera detection and combat support inside the cathedral depends on siphoning-linked optics/power; non-mana chemical interference plus Thần Tinh sabotage can blind or depower that support before ordinary physical attacks finish the unit.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Elena’s chemical disruption suppresses the optical/siphoning network and nullification explosives sever the copper supports.

memories.chapter_title: VÒM ĐIỆN THÁNH CƯỜNG VÀ BÓNG SÁT THỦ VESPERA
memories.content: With the Vespera force and central cathedral lens disabled, a spiral stair to the Origin Altar is exposed and the coalition begins the final ascent toward Alistair.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The fallen bronze door reveals the spiral stair directly toward the Origin Altar.

memories.chapter_title: VỰC THẲM ĐÀI TẾ KHỞI NGUYÊN
memories.content: At the Origin Altar, Alistair’s mechanical right arm is shown with the Mảnh Lõi Không Gian embedded in it; the core powers spatial/gravity distortions used directly against Alan.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Alistair appears with a mechanical right arm carrying the Space Core and uses it for spatial/gravity attacks.

memories.chapter_title: VỰC THẲM ĐÀI TẾ KHỞI NGUYÊN
memories.content: Alistair directly says that after defeating the Demon King he saw the void and recognized the world as an artificial enclosure made by the “Gods,” independently reinforcing the false-sky history previously narrated in chapter 54.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Alistair explicitly recounts seeing the void/artificial cage after the Demon King victory.

memories.chapter_title: VỰC THẲM ĐÀI TẾ KHỞI NGUYÊN
memories.content: During the final confrontation Alistair directly threatens to smash the artificial enclosure together with all living beings inside it; this is his explicit current stated intent at chapter 58 and should not be retroactively substituted for his earlier preservation-through-sacrifice rationale.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Alistair says he will break the cage along with all living beings inside it.

memories.chapter_title: VỰC THẲM ĐÀI TẾ KHỞI NGUYÊN
memories.content: When Alistair breaks Alan’s ribs and drives metal near his left lung, Elena performs emergency non-mana surgery under battle conditions, stabilizes him, and enables him to return to the fight.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Elena extracts the metal fragment, controls the wound with mundane medical tools and herbs, and Alan rises to continue fighting.

memories.chapter_title: VỰC THẲM ĐÀI TẾ KHỞI NGUYÊN
memories.content: The Thần Tinh sword’s nullification property can cancel the spatial/gravity energy emitted by Alistair’s Space Core at contact; Alan uses it to cut through the gravity attack and shatter the core on the prosthetic arm.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Alan’s Thần Tinh strike nullifies the spatial attack and destroys the Space Core/prosthetic-arm power source.

memories.chapter_title: VỰC THẲM ĐÀI TẾ KHỞI NGUYÊN
memories.content: Alan defeats Alistair at the Origin Altar by using the Thần Tinh sword to nullify his spatial attack and destroy the Space Core/prosthetic arm after Elena stabilizes Alan’s severe chest injury.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The final duel ends with the Space Core shattered, Alistair kneeling defeated, and his spatial power gone.

memories.chapter_title: BÌNH MINH TỰ DO ĐẦU TIÊN
memories.content: After his defeat, Alistair acknowledges the natural sky, closes his eyes, and the narration depicts him sinking permanently into death, ending the central adversarial conflict.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Alistair’s final exchange ends with him closing his eyes and “chìm vào bóng tối vĩnh hằng.”

memories.chapter_title: BÌNH MINH TỰ DO ĐẦU TIÊN
memories.content: Alan cuts the final siphoning cable with the Thần Tinh sword; the Earth Vein Core is released from extraction and natural energy flow returns into the underground network, beginning recovery of damaged water and land.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The final copper siphoning line is severed and the Earth Vein Core resumes a free natural pulse.

memories.chapter_title: BÌNH MINH TỰ DO ĐẦU TIÊN
memories.content: Once the final siphoning connection is broken, the source depicts the Earth Vein Core’s natural flow reversing back into the land rather than being consumed by Solaria’s artificial system; ecological recovery begins without the Temple network.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The freed Earth Vein Core sends natural energy back along the underground veins and begins restoring water and soil.

memories.chapter_title: BÌNH MINH TỰ DO ĐẦU TIÊN
memories.content: The artificial sky system collapses broadly enough for Solaria’s population to experience natural stars and the first natural sunrise; the story treats this as the end of the Temple-controlled sky order rather than another local breach.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The false-sky structure breaks down and Solaria residents see natural sunlight directly.

memories.chapter_title: BÌNH MINH TỰ DO ĐẦU TIÊN
memories.content: Valora declares the wartime pact completed after Alistair’s fall, says Demon forces will return to the northern lands, and explicitly frames them as a reliable rear-area partner rather than renewed enemies.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Valora closes the campaign pact but maintains a friendly allied posture toward Oakhaven.

memories.chapter_title: BÌNH MINH TỰ DO ĐẦU TIÊN
memories.content: Alan and Elena explicitly decide to return to Oakhaven, with Elena framing the return around planting the first “seeds of freedom” in the red-maple valley.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The final Solaria scene ends with Alan and Elena agreeing to go home to Oakhaven.

memories.chapter_title: LUYỆN KIẾM THÀNH CÀY
memories.content: Captured Temple metal and bulk Thần Tinh are repurposed into plows, hoes, shovels and construction hardware for reconstruction, while Alan still retains his personal Thần Tinh short sword; the chapter does not say his sword itself is melted down.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Bram/Brand forge agricultural tools from recovered metal and Thần Tinh while Alan’s personal sword remains on his lap.

memories.chapter_title: LUYỆN KIẾM THÀNH CÀY
memories.content: During postwar recovery Alan’s right-shoulder wound has closed, his right-eye hemorrhage is almost gone, and his broken mana core is quiet under the natural sky; Elena still limits heavy sword use while the body heals.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The chapter explicitly describes Alan’s shoulder healed, vision nearly restored, and mana-core pain absent during recovery.

memories.chapter_title: LUYỆN KIẾM THÀNH CÀY
memories.content: Alan proposes that Oakhaven and the northern Demon lands replace wartime necessity with open trade through Hẻm Vực Tro Tàn; Garrick and Valora seal the postwar arrangement with a handshake and Valora promises security for the return corridor.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Alan proposes trade, Garrick and Valora clasp hands, and Valora commits Demon protection of the ravine route.

memories.chapter_title: LUYỆN KIẾM THÀNH CÀY
memories.content: Elena gives Gargas written non-mana medical methods for treating ozone/ma-corruption and brass-needle techniques; Gargas answers with a reciprocal offer of northern metal and stone resources.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Elena transfers medical knowledge to Gargas; he promises reciprocal material access.

memories.chapter_title: LUYỆN KIẾM THÀNH CÀY
memories.content: Sael remains in Solaria to rebuild the former Temple center into civilian housing and medical infrastructure, while the Oakhaven survivors depart with food, seeds and agricultural tools to reconstruct their valley.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Sael stays to rebuild Solaria and the Oakhaven convoy begins its return journey.

memories.chapter_title: HẠT GIỐNG TRỞ VỀ OAKHAVEN
memories.content: On the return to Oakhaven, the soil is moist again, underground water is clean, and new red-maple growth is visible in the burned valley, providing direct local evidence of ecological recovery after the siphoning system ended.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Elena tests moist healthy soil; the valley contains clean water and large numbers of new red-maple shoots.

memories.chapter_title: HẠT GIỐNG TRỞ VỀ OAKHAVEN
memories.content: The returning Oakhaven community immediately begins rebuilding homes, the forge, fields and medical space using ordinary labor and the agricultural tools brought from Solaria.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The returnees clear ruins, restart the forge, cut timber, till soil, and rebuild village infrastructure.

memories.chapter_title: HẠT GIỐNG TRỞ VỀ OAKHAVEN
memories.content: Elena recovers a preserved notebook of mundane medical knowledge and a set of brass acupuncture needles from the ruins of the old healer house, preserving a prewar medical legacy for the rebuilt settlement.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: A protected box under the ruined healer house contains the medical notebook and brass needles intact.

memories.chapter_title: HẠT GIỐNG TRỞ VỀ OAKHAVEN
memories.content: Elena plants new red-maple seeds in soil Alan has tilled and waters them with clean stream water; the source does not explicitly identify these seeds as the same physical reserve seeds evacuated in chapter 17.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Elena plants red-maple seeds during reconstruction; their physical provenance is not tied to the chapter-17 reserve cache.

memories.chapter_title: HẠT GIỐNG TRỞ VỀ OAKHAVEN
memories.content: At the new memorial for Gregor and Oakhaven’s dead, Alan plants his personal Thần Tinh short sword beside the monument and declares its wartime mission finished, retiring the weapon rather than melting it into a farming tool.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Alan places the Thần Tinh sword at the memorial and says steel will now serve plows and life.

memories.chapter_title: HẠT GIỐNG TRỞ VỀ OAKHAVEN
memories.content: The ending places Alan and Elena together in rebuilt Oakhaven: Elena confirms his shoulder is functioning normally, they hold hands on the new infirmary porch, and she rests her head on his shoulder while they look over the replanted valley.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Alan and Elena share the rebuilt infirmary porch and the final quiet scene together.

memories.chapter_title: HẠT GIỐNG TRỞ VỀ OAKHAVEN
memories.content: The novel closes with Oakhaven actively rebuilt under the natural sky, new crops and red-maple growth underway, and the narration declaring the beginning of an era of mortal self-rule.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The final paragraphs show rebuilt Oakhaven, natural stars, new growth and the explicit end-state of mortal self-rule.

memories.chapter_title: HẠT GIỐNG TRỞ VỀ OAKHAVEN
memories.content: Chapter 61 explicitly dates Roland’s burning of Oakhaven and Gregor’s death to roughly two years before the return, providing the manuscript’s clearest late temporal anchor even though intervening chapters rarely mark elapsed calendar time.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: The narrator twice refers to the Oakhaven destruction/Gregor death as having happened two years earlier.
